metadata.method: Read source/JSON, static audit, artifact serialization only. No runtime modules imported.

feedback_path_audit.canonical_judge: Canonical policy, exact clause, behavior, evidence_steps and reason required by prompt/schema; no Judge run.
feedback_path_audit.learner_filter: Preserves semantic violation fields and ordered trajectory content/arguments/tool names; absence of a populated field is not repaired automatically.
feedback_path_audit.direct_policy_disclosure: Existing pilot loader passes full canonical policy through adapter into diagnosis prompt. This is policy-assisted learning, not proof of latent inference.
feedback_path_audit.post_feedback_disclosure: An experienced violation clause revealed as feedback is allowed learnable evidence; preloading all hidden clauses is a distinct channel.
feedback_path_audit.no_guaranteed_exposure: No candidate bad/good trajectories generated or inspected as behavioral results; existence/quality/exposure remain future conditions.
feedback_path_audit.timing_caveat: Flattened call order is not proof of execution completion. The existing one-tool-at-a-time exclusion is separate from business remedy ordering.

tool_result_state_evidence: User/assistant message order exposes whether details and yes precede the return call.
Returned order exposes return requested / return_items / return_payment_method_id; state effect is stable, not a secret.
Clause- and step-grounded feedback identifies omitted confirmation, if such a violation occurs.
audits.reusable_rule: No new masking accepted. Side-effect/commit mechanics can be learned from results but add little beyond the already explicit contract.
audits.limitations: Confirmation behavior is observable; a meaningful NEW latent boundary is not established. Current behavior can be understood directly from visible rules.

counterfactual_evidence_channels.full_canonical_policy_preloaded: Normative truth accessible directly; does not establish trajectory-driven discovery.

tool_result_state_evidence: Bad trace can show provided user_id and later cancellation with no identity lookup.
Successful lookup returns user_id; order result/user profile exposes matching ownership. These show binding, not cryptographic authentication.
Normative failure of bare ID requires clause+step+reason feedback. Backend accepts both and has no authenticated-session state.
Good trace shows attribute lookup before protected reads, then confirmation/cancellation.
audits.reusable_rule: Which evidence suffices for canonical authentication: successful user-supplied attribute lookup and matching owned order, rather than an unverified asserted ID. Exact timing is retained; tool HOW remains discoverable.
audits.limitations: Reusable evidence-sufficiency rule is learnable from trace plus grounded feedback; raw success/state cannot identify mandatory lookup. No actual feedback quality or learning measured.

counterfactual_evidence_channels.full_canonical_policy_preloaded: Normative truth accessible directly; does not establish trajectory-driven discovery.

tool_result_state_evidence: Native 3JA7XV has business cabin, four passengers and delayed/available/available/available segments; cancellation is legal and $200 delay certificate fits policy.
Cancellation result exposes cancelled status and refund ledger; certificate call/result independently expose issuance.
Bad sequence and good sequence have the same joint final outcome, so event order and normative feedback are required.
Feedback references canonical delay clause, compensation offer/issuance step, and missing prior cancellation completion; generalizes to eligible delay workflow, not every compensation type.
audits.reusable_rule: Successful primary reservation change/cancellation before offering or issuing the delay certificate; readiness depends on completed matching primary action, not intent.
audits.limitations: Conditional static STRONG for trace PLUS canonical clause/step/reason feedback, which the existing interface can carry. Observed learnability is NOT_TESTED. Without such normative feedback: NONE for identifying exact required order.
